## Line 446

```plato

    // How many vertices neighbour BOTH ends of an edge.
    SharedNeighborCount(neighbors: Array<Array<VertexIndex>>, pair: VertexPair): Integer
        => neighbors[pair.A.Value]
            .Map(n => RowContains(neighbors[pair.B.Value], n) ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit);
```
